in_arabic.name: Raoofah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Raoofah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root ‘rafa’ which means ‘to raise, lift up, or be high’. The name Raoofah is considered to be a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl, signifying her connection to the divine and her potential to soar to great heights.
